c79dfffcac4a5e3aa9c8621bc8d9ee2ee8d0dacc.summary: CrowdStrike's blog describes HURRICANE PANDA, a China-based actor it has investigated since 2013. The actor targeted telecommunications and technology companies using China Chopper webshells, credential theft tools and a Windows kernel zero-day (CVE-2014-4113). CrowdStrike Falcon detection and enterprise-wide remediation were reported to stop the intrusions, and the report describes the actor abandoning its attempts after the actor found CrowdStrike running on a victim system.

c74fa7ce49633c59300341d4eff91fc1618689de.summary: A GitHub project readme for Revenant, a third-party agent (implant) for the Havoc command-and-control framework, written in C and based on the Talon implant. It covers setup steps, supported Havoc versions, x86 and Windows 7 compatibility notes, the available commands, build options such as sleep timing, polymorphism, string obfuscation and unhooking, and a TODO list. It describes a software tool and does not report a threat actor, campaign, incident or vulnerability.

c77fcf46b9d3f1ca7121da40666f05358fc29163.summary: Malpedia family entry for MedusaLocker, a Windows ransomware that runs tasks to prepare the target system before encrypting files. It uses AES and RSA-2048 and reportedly appends extensions such as .encrypted. Most of the page is a dated list of reports on the family from vendors and agencies, from 2019 to 2023, including a 2022 CISA advisory. The page was archived on 2026-04-02.
